notes.note: Searched this document for claims about the changed behavior Changed sources: a fresh home may hold the archive CLI's own state/<channel>/instances records (#4381); start now restarts an instance whose core server is dead instead of reporting it running (#4002), and a failed start names the connect error, the logged cause and the log path (#4382); an empty .git placeholder no longer turns a signed archive into a checkout; a gitfile or a .git with HEAD still does (#4380). No remaining claim here contradicts them.
